transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started with the weekly power-support meeting. We've got four portable power units — P-1, P-2, P-3, and P-4 — all listed as serviceable and available. They need to cover the clinic, communications shelter, battery shop, and refrigerated storage area for the coming week. I'd like each of you to brief your area's needs so we can finalize the allocation and I can sign the support plan. Let's start with the power representative.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Good morning, Colonel. Before we get into assignments, I need to flag something important from yesterday's electrical inspection. P-2 is the only unit equipped with the recently certified isolated-output transformer that the clinic's sensitive diagnostic equipment requires. The certification entry is still pending on the base inventory board, so it may not be reflected there yet — but I personally confirmed it during the inspection. I'd recommend we assign P-2 to the clinic to ensure their diagnostic gear is properly protected.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Colonel, I need to flag something for the communications shelter. I confirmed this morning that the communications shelter's equipment requires regulated 28-volt output, which only P-4 provides. The updated compatibility note hasn't been added to the signal support annex yet, but P-4 must go to the communications shelter to meet that voltage requirement.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Colonel, I need to flag something for the battery shop. I confirmed with the battery-shop supervisor that their charging rack requires P-1's approved connector and grounding lead. The shop's revised power worksheet hasn't been forwarded to the base planning cell yet, so this requirement may not be on anyone else's radar. P-1 needs to go to the battery shop to meet that connector and grounding requirement.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: Colonel, I need to flag something for the refrigerated storage area. I confirmed that the refrigerated storage area will receive a continuous-temperature shipment requiring P-3's 24-hour runtime capability. The receiving manifest hasn't been linked to the power-allocation request yet, so this requirement may not be visible to anyone else here. P-3 needs to go to the refrigerated storage area to support that shipment.
